paragraphs: Industrial/Organizational Solutions designs tests and assessments that organizations use to hire and promote individuals. The specialty is fire service, law enforcement, and corrections hiring and promotion. The site describes a consulting firm for public safety agencies working on personnel selection through preparation and testing.

The product list includes entry-level law enforcement exams. Promotional exams are offered for the fire service as well. Corrections agencies have their own entry-level exams. Customization and consulting sit alongside the catalog products. A free validation study is also listed.
The site sorts visitors into agencies and applicants. Applicants can reach study materials for law enforcement exams. The company lists an address on Kensington Road in Oak Brook, Illinois.

quote.text: IO Solutions is a consulting firm for public safety agencies that specializes in personnel selection through preparation and testing solutions.
